'''Pyro Gibbtra''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who worked for the powerful company [[Sygor Startech Industries]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. While working on a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Engine/Legends|engine]] design known as the [[Event Horizon (engine)|Event Horizon]], Gibbtra disappeared with the designs, with his last known location being [[Zirtran's Anchor/Legends|Zirtran's Anchor]], a trade [[Space station/Legends|station]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. The [[Skine Bounty Hunter College]] was subsequently contracted to retrieve Gibbra and the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zeed Venom]] was dispatched to Zirtran's Anchor to search for him.<ref name="Live-Action Adventures" />
